blocks.title: Translators
blocks.text: Translators woh tools hain jo ek programming language ka code aisi zaban mein badalte hain jo computer samajh sake: yeh Python jaisi high-level languages ko machine language (binary code) mein badalte hain jise computer chala sake.

blocks.caption: Translator ki do qismein
rows: code line ba line badalta hai
poora code ek saath badalta hai

blocks.prompt: Interpreter compiler se kaise mukhtalif hai?
blocks.explanation: Interpreter program ko ek waqt mein ek line badal kar chalata hai; compiler chalane se pehle poore program ko machine code mein badalta hai.

items: Translators high-level code ko machine language mein badalte hain; interpreters line ba line (Python), compilers ek saath (GCC).
